name: all
comments: All subjects received short-term emergency drugs before dissection, including dopamine, dobutamine, epinephrine, lidocaine, sodium nitroprusside, vasopressin, cephalosporines, gentamycin, vancomycin, clindamycin, insulin, mannitol, and dexamethasone. Of these drugs, only dexamethasone is known to be a potential inducer of intestinal genes of metabolism and transport. The drug was administered intravenously as a single dose in only two of our six donors approximately 24−28 h before tissue sampling, which is not expected to cause significant induction of intestinal transporters.
